sentences.en: A rifle shot broke the peace of the early morning.
sentences.zh: 一声步枪射击打破了清晨的宁静。

sentences.en: The soldier refused to fire his rifle at the enemy.
sentences.zh: 士兵拒绝用他的步枪向敌人开火。

sentences.en: I have never aimed at a bear with my rifle.
sentences.zh: 我从未用我的步枪瞄准过一只熊。

senses.zh: 快速搜寻,匆忙翻找 ,偷窃,盗取
